children: shares climbed 2% in Monday morning trading after Bank of America upgraded the stock to Buy from Underperform and raised its price target to $285 from $160.
The rally also came as the software company advanced its AI strategy through a planned acquisition of analytics startup Loops.

Bank of America's upgrade reflects expectations that wider AI adoption could increase demand for Salesforce's existing software platforms rather than replace them. Analyst Tal Liani believes large enterprises are likely to retain established systems that manage data, workflows and compliance as they introduce AI tools.

Separately, Salesforce plans to acquire Loops, which uses machine learning to analyze business performance, explain changes in key metrics and identify potential opportunities. Salesforce intends to integrate the startup's technology into Tableau, its data visualization and analytics platform.

However, the growth outlook remains uncertain. Slower customer adoption of AI could delay the expected financial benefits, while AI-related revenue remains relatively small compared with Salesforce's overall business. Investors will be watching whether its expanding AI offerings translate into stronger sales growth.

title: Salesforce Stock Jumps as Bank of America Delivers Double Upgrade
